questions.prompt: What does the cow give us?
questions.evidenceText: A cow gives us milk. We drink milk every day.

questions.prompt: What food does a hen give us?
questions.evidenceText: A hen lays eggs. We can eat the eggs.

questions.prompt: What does the book show that farm animals give us?
choices: farm animals all roll in mud
farm animals all swim in ponds
questions.evidenceText: Farms give us food. Thank you, farm animals!
